## Checklist
- [ ] Title follows the commit types in CONTRIBUTING.md (`feat:`, `fix:`, `tokens:`, `docs:` …), with `!` if it breaks consumers
- [ ] Every new value traces to a token or a stated reason
- [ ] Light and dark were changed together and both meet WCAG AA
- [ ] At most one filled accent per view; status colors used for status only
- [ ] Copy is sentence case, no exclamation marks, labels name the action
- [ ] Motion uses the duration tokens and respects reduced motion
- [ ] New or changed components have `.jsx`, `.d.ts`, `.prompt.md`, a card, and an export in `src/index.js` and `src/index.d.ts`
- [ ] `readme.md` and `SKILL.md` updated if a rule changed
